sources.entry: Mac Clean - Free, open-source cleaner, optimizer, and malware scanner. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/iliyami/MacClean) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Mac Sai is a free, open-source, Apple-notarized Mac cleaner, optimizer, and malware scanner built in Swift 6 and SwiftUI as an alternative to CleanMyMac.
summary.what_it_does: Mac Sai is a SwiftUI macOS app that organizes about 22 modules into cleanup, protection, performance, applications, and file-management categories. Cleanup covers system junk scanning across 16+ categories, mail attachment cache removal, trash emptying, project build-folder detection (such as node_modules, target, and Pods), and Docker and Xcode simulator pruning. Protection includes a signature-based malware scanner, browser history and cache cleaning, browser extension listing, and saved Wi-Fi management. Applications covers an uninstaller that searches for leftover files, a reset-to-defaults option, unused-app detection, and a Sparkle-feed updater. Files includes a disk treemap, large and old file finder, duplicate detection with APFS clone consolidation, and a secure shredder. A menu-bar widget shows live CPU, memory, disk, and battery stats. Deletion defaults to the Trash, and a dry-run mode is available.
use_cases: Free up disk space on a Mac
Remove an app and its leftover files
Find and delete old build folders like node_modules
Scan a Mac for malware or adware
Clear browser history, cookies, and cache
Find large files and duplicate files
Manage login items and launch agents
how_to_run: Or download the latest notarized DMG from the project's Releases page and drag Mac Sai to Applications
Build from source: git clone the repository, cd MacSai, then swift build
bash scripts/build-dmg.sh (builds a local unsigned DMG)
notable: Apple-notarized and code-signed with Developer ID, with zero telemetry according to the README, which includes commands to verify network use
Trash-first deletion, a protected-paths blocklist, symlink and TOCTOU guards, and a SafetyGuard that validates every path
Universal Binary thinning that rewrites fat Mach-O binaries to the native arch via lipo
Duplicate detection with a Consolidate mode that uses APFS copy-on-write clones instead of deleting copies
Project Junk only flags build folders when the surrounding project files confirm the project type
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later, and the Swift 6 toolchain (Xcode 16+) for building from source
The README says it is not an antivirus; the malware scanner is signature-based and flags items for review
A few modules (Mail Attachments, Privacy, Malware) need Full Disk Access granted manually
The optional MalwareBazaar hash feed requires the user to supply their own abuse.ch Auth-Key
